title: Variant Gatekeeper: Automated Certification and Drift Alerts for Low-Precision Model Variants
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: We onboard many low-precision variants (INT8 / FP8 / GPTQ / AWQ). Current intake validates basic perf numbers but lacks an automated gate that (1) certifies a variant against a compact set of production-like prompts, (2) produces a machine-readable certification artifact to be pinned in the model registry, and (3) continuously watches for quality or latency regressions after publication. Without this, bad quant artifacts occasionally roll out and cause customer-facing regressions or elevated token costs.
scope:
Build a 'Variant Gatekeeper' service that runs an automated certification checklist for quant artifacts and ties certification state into pin publishing. The gate will: run perf + quality tests, compute contract metrics (latency p50/p95/p99, token cost delta, eval metric delta), publish a signed certification artifact, and emit alerts if a deployed variant drifts beyond configured thresholds. Integrate with existing pin registry and canary routing.
Out of scope: full retraining or automatic re-quantization; UI work beyond minimal console indicators (separate PM ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper runs a deterministic test harness for each incoming quant artifact (supports INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) and emits a JSON certification artifact with: model_id, quant_type, artifact_hash, baseline_commit, metrics snapshot, and pass/fail result
Certification includes signed metric contracts: latency_p50, latency_p95, latency_p99, gen_token_cost_delta, eval_score_delta. Thresholds are configurable per-model family and stored in config-store
Post-publish watcher compares live telemetry to certification snapshot and triggers an alert when any contracted metric exceeds threshold for a sustained window (configurable, default 10min)
Gatekeeper publishes pin to pin-registry only when certification is PASS and required approvals are present; blocked otherwise

End-to-end test: create a synthetic bad-quant artifact that regresses p99 latency by >30% and show gate fails and blocks publish; create a variant that meets thresholds and show publish + watcher passes
Telemetry contract documented and unit/integration tests added; rollout plan for canary traffic in Dedicated clusters described in release notes
implementation_steps: Design certification schema (artifact JSON) and add to spec registry
Extend quant-intake pipeline to produce deterministic seed for evaluation harness
Implement Gatekeeper runner: fetch artifact, spin ephemeral runtime (cpu/gpu), run perf harness & eval dataset, compute metrics
Integrate with pin-registry API: conditional publish + signed artifact storage
Wire post-publish watcher: sampling policies, metric aggregation, alerting exporters
Add canary policy hooks: support 0.5/1/5/100% traffic ramp and automatic rollback trigger
Add e2e tests and synthetic regression scenarios; add CI job to validate gate behavior
notes: Trade-offs: running the full eval suite on every artifact is expensive; we will use a compact production-like prompt set (~200 prompts) for initial certification and schedule nightly expanded suites for high-priority models
Decision: use signed JSON artifacts (ed25519) to allow downstream services to verify certification provenance
Integration: will rely on existing telemetry ingest and metric-contract keys defined by ENG-40227
Fallback: if ephemeral runner fails to boot, mark artifact as 'blocked-ephemeral-failure' and surface to SRE for manual triage
